name: DeepMind Melting Pot
description: Multi-agent evaluation suite from DeepMind comprising over 50 substrates (social environments) and hundreds of test scenarios that assess an agent's ability to generalise cooperative and competitive social behaviour to novel partners and situations. Melting Pot tests social intelligence by pairing trained agents with unfamiliar co-players.
typical_sota_score: Varies by substrate; many substrates remain challenging for current agents.
reputation: Major benchmark for social AI; well-received in the MARL community for addressing generalisation gaps in prior cooperative benchmarks.
notes: Requires running multi-agent RL training; computationally expensive. Generalisation to novel partners remains an open challenge.
